description: If you keep trying to manifest money but still feel like you're waiting, this Neville Goddard-inspired SATS practice will show you a different approach: choose one short scene that implies the financial outcome is already complete, enter it before sleep, and stop rehearsing lack during the day. This video breaks down living in the end, SATS, money self-concept, daytime assumptions, and a one-minute practice you can use tonight. No guaranteed financial claims — just a clear application of Neville's state-based method.
